definition.note: No closed form is stored for this surface. It is defined by its shipped implementation in math_art.curiosity_surface_generator, which is authoritative; an unverified transcription would silently define a different surface.

provenance.definition: Derived from the Math Art generator registries and cross-referenced to the literature; not transcribed from any gallery's compilation.
sources: H. A. Schwarz, 'Sur une definition erronee de l'aire d'une surface courbe', Gesammelte Mathematische Abhandlungen (1890).

caveats: THE cautionary counterexample: a polyhedral approximation to a cylinder whose area DIVERGES as the mesh is refined. Any generator that measures a discrete surface and assumes convergence is wrong in exactly this way.
